description: This file initializes Icelandic locale settings for git internationalization tests, sourcing external library and conditionally including additional scripts based on environment prerequisites.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if a specific prerequisite (like GETTEXT) is available in the environment.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Marks a prerequisite (like GETTEXT_LOCALE or GETTEXT_ISO_LOCALE) as available for testing.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Outputs a message, typically for logging or informational purposes.
